title: Generative AI impact on protein stability prediction in breast cancer genes
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AlphaFold2生成结构结合FoldX等预测BRCA等抑癌基因错义变体的蛋白稳定性，虽涉及蛋白结构预测与功能关联，但核心是变异致病性分类而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract:
The functional classification of a missense variant in cancer predisposition genes is often challenging due to how rare the variant is observed in the population. When available, clinicians utilize a combination of family history, in vitro functional assays and in silico methods to infer protein function. In silico methods, such as missense predictors (predict changes in protein function) and protein stability predictors (predict changes in free energy) have been used to help classify a missense variant in accordance with the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG) guideline. To measure protein stability, many in silico algorithms predict stability based on the change of free energy and most accurate protein stability predictors require a wild-type protein template. In this study, we examine the use of generative AI to predict high-resolution protein structures as templates analyzed with protein stability methods to evaluate loss of function (LOF) activity in cancer predisposition genes BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2 and RAD51C upon the presence of missense variant. Utilizing multiplexed assay of variant effect measurements and variant classifications from ClinVar, we find that prediction of Gibbs free energy (ΔΔG) from AlphaFold2 (AF2) structures analyzed with FoldX predicts LOF better than experimental-derived wild type structures in the BRCT domain of BRCA1 and the DNA binding domain (DBD) of BRCA2 , but not in PALB2 and RAD51C . We also find that AF2 structures in the BRCT domain of BRCA1 and DBD-Dss1 domain of BRCA2 analyzed with FoldX measure homologous DNA recombination (HDR) activity significantly better than Rosetta and DDGun3D. Our study also revealed that there are other factors that contribute to predicting loss of function activity other than protein stability, with AlphaMissense ranking the best overall predictor of LOF activity in these tumor suppressor breast cancer genes.

Author Summary

The stability of a protein, often expressed in terms of Gibbs free energy (ΔΔG), is a critical factor in predicting loss of function (LOF) activity when a missense variant is present. The effect is higher in haploinsufficient genes like the tumor suppressor genes BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2 and RAD51C . Protein stability predictors that utilizes a wild-type structure to make its predictions is often limited by the availability of experimentally-derived protein structures. Here, in our study we show that generative AI, like AlphaFold2 (AF2) can predict structures similar to experimentally-derived structures with high similarity. Furthermore, protein stability tools such as FoldX, Rosetta, and DDGun3D can be used in conjunction to measure changes in stability. From our study, we find that complex AF2 structures representing the BRCT domain of BRCA1 and DBD domain of BRCA2 analyzed by FoldX predicts function significantly better than the experimentally-derived structures. However, predicted |ΔΔG| does not predict function better than purpose-built in silico missense predictors for protein function. Overall, we find the AlphaMissense is the best predictor to predict function in these tumor suppressor breast cancer genes.
abstract_zh:
癌症易感基因中错义变异的功能分类通常具有挑战性，因为该变异在人群中的观察频率极为罕见。在可用的情况下，临床医生会结合家族史、体外功能实验和计算机模拟方法来推断蛋白质功能。计算机模拟方法，如错义预测器（预测蛋白质功能变化）和蛋白质稳定性预测器（预测自由能变化），已被用于根据美国医学遗传学与基因组学学院（ACMG）指南帮助分类错义变异。为测量蛋白质稳定性，许多计算机模拟算法基于自由能变化进行预测，而最准确的蛋白质稳定性预测器通常需要野生型蛋白质模板。在本研究中，我们探讨了使用生成式人工智能预测高分辨率蛋白质结构作为模板，并结合蛋白质稳定性方法分析，以评估癌症易感基因BRCA1、BRCA2、PALB2和RAD51C在存在错义变异时的功能丧失（LOF）活性。利用多重变异效应测量分析和ClinVar中的变异分类，我们发现，使用FoldX分析AlphaFold2（AF2）结构预测的吉布斯自由能（ΔΔG），在BRCA1的BRCT结构域和BRCA2的DNA结合结构域（DBD）中，比实验衍生的野生型结构更能预测LOF，但在PALB2和RAD51C中则不然。我们还发现，使用FoldX分析BRCA1的BRCT结构域和BRCA2的DBD-Dss1结构域中的AF2结构，测量同源DNA重组（HDR）活性的效果显著优于Rosetta和DDGun3D。我们的研究还揭示，除蛋白质稳定性外，还有其他因素有助于预测功能丧失活性，其中AlphaMissense在这些肿瘤抑制乳腺癌基因中排名为LOF活性的最佳整体预测器。

作者摘要

蛋白质的稳定性，通常以吉布斯自由能（ΔΔG）表示，是预测存在错义变异时功能丧失（LOF）活性的关键因素。这种效应在单倍剂量不足基因中更为显著，如肿瘤抑制基因BRCA1、BRCA2、PALB2和RAD51C。利用野生型结构进行预测的蛋白质稳定性预测器，往往受限于实验衍生的蛋白质结构的可用性。在本研究中，我们表明生成式人工智能，如AlphaFold2（AF2），可以预测与实验衍生结构高度相似的蛋白质结构。此外，蛋白质稳定性工具如FoldX、Rosetta和DDGun3D可结合使用以测量稳定性变化。从我们的研究中发现，使用FoldX分析代表BRCA1的BRCT结构域和BRCA2的DBD结构域的复杂AF2结构，预测功能的效果显著优于实验衍生结构。然而，预测的|ΔΔG|并不比专门构建的计算机模拟错义预测器更能预测蛋白质功能。总体而言，我们发现AlphaMissense是预测这些肿瘤抑制乳腺癌基因功能的最佳预测器。
